description: This file implements a NetworkManagerProxy for RDK, handling network interface states, IP configurations, WiFi operations, and event handling via IARM bus, with functions for scanning, connecting, and managing WiFi and network interfaces.

classes.name: NetworkManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing network management functions, event registration, and IP/WiFi operations for RDK platform.

methods.name: to_wifi_state
methods.description: Converts WiFiStatusCode_t to INetworkManager::WiFiState.

methods.name: errorcode_to_wifi_state
methods.description: Converts WiFiErrorCode_t to WiFiState.

methods.name: mapToLegacySecurityMode
methods.description: Maps security mode to legacy integer value.

methods.name: mapToNewSecurityMode
methods.description: Maps legacy security mode to new enum.

methods.name: alreadySentRecently
methods.description: Checks if an event was recently sent for a network interface to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: NetworkManagerInternalEventHandler
methods.description: Handles IARM bus events related to network interfaces, IP addresses, WiFi state, and SSID list updates.

methods.name: threadEventRegistration
methods.description: Registers for IARM bus events in a separate thread, with retries.

methods.name: getInitialConnectionState
methods.description: Queries current network interfaces and reports their state at startup.

methods.name: platform_logging
methods.description: Placeholder for setting platform-specific logging level.

methods.name: SetHostname
methods.description: Stub for setting DHCP hostname.

methods.name: platform_init
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus, registers event handlers, and retrieves current network state.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves list of network interfaces (eth0, wlan0) via IARM.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a network interface (eth0/wlan0).

methods.name: GetInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if a network interface (eth0/wlan0) is enabled.

methods.name: NetmaskToPrefix
methods.description: Converts netmask string to prefix length.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP configuration for a network interface.

methods.name: SetIPSettings
methods.description: Sets IP configuration for a network interface.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan
methods.description: Starts WiFi scan with optional SSID filtering and frequency.

methods.name: StopWiFiScan
methods.description: Stops ongoing WiFi scan.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Retrieves list of known/connected SSIDs.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds an SSID to known list.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSID
methods.description: Removes SSID from known list.

methods.name: WiFiConnect
methods.description: Connects to specified WiFi network.

methods.name: WiFiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects current WiFi connection.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves info of currently connected SSID.

methods.name: StartWPS
methods.description: Initiates WPS pairing with specified method.

methods.name: StopWPS
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WPS pairing.

methods.name: GetWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves current WiFi state.
